assessments.summary: The source-level construction appears sound and complete for the explicitly defined rct4 subclass, and the half-turn, quarter-turn, occupancy, and centered-half-turn arguments are correct. However, the declared claim materially overstates that result: the lemma does not prove that rct4 is the unique viable rotational route. A general 154-point set invariant under the centered half-turn may consist of arbitrary antipodal pairs without satisfying the rct4 requirements of complete quarter-turn orbits, an empty anti-diagonal, and exactly one main-diagonal pair. The contribution itself admits this larger, unencoded rot2 class. It also does not prove the asserted classification of all possible rotations, having treated only half- and quarter-turns. These defects decisively invalidate the claim as written, although the artifact makes no unsupported change to the certified bound 152 <= D(77) <= 154.
scopeQualifications: The invalidity concerns the asserted uniqueness and exhaustiveness of the rotational route, not the apparent correctness of the encoding within the expressly defined rct4 subclass.
For n=77, the orbit counts 1444 off-diagonal variables and 38 diagonal-pair variables follow correctly; choosing 38 and 1 respectively yields 154 points.
The primitive-direction maximal-line enumeration and weighted at-most-two inequalities appear sound and complete for detecting collinear triples within the rct4 model.
The exact-integer certificate checker and the five committed calibration certificates support the listed examples, but not universal historical claims about every known odd-size record.
The bounded searches correctly carry no implication of infeasibility and do not alter the global bounds on D(77).
The rotational lemma says nothing about reflection, glide symmetry, or asymmetric configurations; 153-point searches and general rot2 searches remain outside the artifact's scope.
evidenceIssues: No argument is supplied that every centered half-turn-invariant 154-point configuration must satisfy the stricter rct4 structure; indeed, the text explicitly acknowledges an omitted general rot2 model.
The inference from analysis of 90-degree and 180-degree rotations to a classification of all nonidentity planar rotations preserving such a grid set is unproved.
The exact reported total of 388,148 deduplicated constraints is a computational output without an independently supplied derivation or generated constraint digest.
The exported CNF's exact correctness depends on external pysat.card.CardEnc.equals semantics, which are not supplied as dependency evidence, and no generated n77.cnf artifact is included.
The CP-SAT and CaDiCaL run histories lack solver logs, status artifacts, timestamps, and result digests; the CaDiCaL invocation and timeout mechanism are not included among the stated commands.

Claims about mutable external database contents, absence of a public preprint, universal historical class membership, and literature resource usage are not established by the declared dependency transactions.

The five reproduced certificates establish only five calibration instances and cannot support the broader assertion that the pipeline or pattern produced every known odd-size record in the stated range.
